title: Force explicit disposition of SEC-AUTO-20260307-01 and SEC-AUTO-20260309-02 (stale open security findings)
summary: Two security findings are 9+ days old with no disposition record. Both need an explicit accept/fix/defer decision with evidence before they can be considered managed.
body: SEC-AUTO-20260307-01 (trust_model.multi_user_heuristic — recurring warning about multi-user heuristic under Telegram group context) and SEC-AUTO-20260309-02 (non-elevated PF posture evidence — pfctl permission denied in cron runtime) have been open for 9+ days as of 2026-03-16. No formal disposition record (accept with rationale, fix plan, or defer with expiry) exists for either. Required actions: (1) SEC-AUTO-20260307-01: write a formal risk-acceptance record or fix plan (trust boundary is partially addressed via 2026-03-09 Sprint 1; determine whether residual heuristic warning is a known-state or needs further tightening); (2) SEC-AUTO-20260309-02: write a formal approved-fallback documentation record or escalate to fix path (non-elevated pfctl is a permanent constraint on macOS; document approved evidence path).
desired_outcome: Both findings have a formal disposition record (accept/fix/defer) with evidence and expiry. Neither ages further without explicit owner sign-off.
success_signal: SEC-AUTO-20260307-01 and SEC-AUTO-20260309-02 both have disposition_state = accepted | fixed | deferred with documented rationale.
